datasets.description: KOI cumulative table joined to Kepler stellar CDPP, reduced to one longest-baseline row per KOI.

retrieval.query: SELECT c.kepid, c.kepoi_name, c.koi_disposition, c.koi_pdisposition, c.koi_period, c.koi_prad, c.koi_sma, c.koi_insol, c.koi_depth, c.koi_duration, c.koi_incl, c.koi_steff, c.koi_srad, c.koi_smass, c.koi_kepmag, c.koi_max_sngle_ev, c.koi_max_mult_ev, c.koi_model_snr, c.koi_num_transits, c.koi_tce_delivname, s.dataspan, s.dutycycle, s.rrmscdpp01p5, s.rrmscdpp02p0, s.rrmscdpp02p5, s.rrmscdpp03p0, s.rrmscdpp03p5, s.rrmscdpp04p5, s.rrmscdpp05p0, s.rrmscdpp06p0, s.rrmscdpp07p5, s.rrmscdpp09p0, s.rrmscdpp10p5, s.rrmscdpp12p0, s.rrmscdpp12p5, s.rrmscdpp15p0 FROM cumulative c JOIN keplerstellar s ON c.kepid = s.kepid WHERE c.koi_period IS NOT NULL AND c.koi_prad IS NOT NULL AND c.koi_srad IS NOT NULL AND c.koi_depth IS NOT NULL AND c.koi_duration IS NOT NULL

source.query_provenance: Exact query and reduction are defined in plotting/scripts/calibration/kepler_calibration.py.

datasets.description: Gaia DR3 sources within 60 pc after parallax precision, RUWE, and photometry quality cuts.

source.query: SELECT source_id, ra, dec, parallax, parallax_error, phot_g_mean_mag, bp_rp, ruwe FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE parallax > 16.667 AND parallax_over_error > 5 AND ruwe < 1.4 AND phot_g_mean_mag IS NOT NULL AND bp_rp IS NOT NULL
source.query_provenance: Exact ADQL is defined as ADQL in PPop/StarCatalogs/build_gaia_60pc.py.

snapshot.date_evidence: Unknown; generated no later than its first commit on 2026-09-13.
